en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a brick cloister or portico with arched arcades and ornate columns, including a central twisted column. The architecture is clearly historic and Italianate. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text indicating the location and subject, and in the upper right there is a circular mark with the letters "M.C.T.".
